name: io.github.oortmem/oort
title: Oort
description: Memory for AI agents that stays correct as facts change.

environmentVariables.name: OORT_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Where Oort keeps your memories. Defaults to ~/.oort, shared with the oort command line.

environmentVariables.name: OORT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Oort Pro key. With it you need no other keys.

environmentVariables.name: VOYAGE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Voyage AI key, for search by meaning. Leave empty to use Oort Pro, or keyword search only.

environmentVariables.name: TYPESAFE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: TypeSafe key, for deciding what to keep when saving. Leave empty to use Oort Pro.

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Anthropic key, for writing saved facts. Leave empty to use Oort Pro.
